shared_elements: schematic human figure with outstretched arms and stick-like limbs
silhouette/solid-filled figures pecked into rock surface
frontal standing human with legs and no facial detail
cup-mark-like round dots on the rock
weapon/staff-like linear attribute held by figure
justification: Both surfaces show the same convention of solid, silhouetted, highly schematic human figures with stick arms held out and simple splayed legs, accompanied by small round cup-like dots, and in both a figure holds an elongated linear implement across the body — a quite specific shared repertoire. The main difference is content density and subject range: B is a multi-figure scene including crewed boats with keel-line strokes and a large horned/animal-like vessel plus a file of spear-bearers, while A shows a single dominant large figure with one small quadruped-like creature beneath it and no boats.
